t: Defeat the Destroyers around the camp.

I believe you agree that this is an obscene number of tin cans. I suggest we reduce their population. We could use a workout, and it’ll get more peaceful here. Or else they might attack the camp while we’re over here.
They’ll break into the camp while we’re off somewhere...
Place Nogrom’s mines around the camp

Once we take care of these things, we should place mines around the camp. If whoever steps on them loses a limb, all the better! But that’s not what they are for! They don’t cause much damage but they make a lot of noise! If anyone gets near the camp - we’ll know right away. If we don’t go deaf...
If anyone gets near the camp - we’ll know right away. If we don’t go deaf...
If you people don’t watch your step, don’t blame me. Make sure everyone in the camp knows!
Find components for Nogrom’s special explosives.

Well, that’s wonderful but we’re waiting for help here. And if we don’t have a way to signal said help, it’s not coming. So what if we ripped a hole through the allod? Would you respond to something like this? I know I’d stay away! We should make signal rockets. And to do that, I’ll need a few things. And then it’s applied pyrotechnics!

Let’s try something. There are bones and remains all over the place - we’ll use them. I’ll need some... ashes.

Poetic! Go get it, I don’t want to stay here longer than necessary.
Great! Why this much? We just want to get their attention, not blow the Citadel up. Although... that will definitely draw attention...
Finally! I’m sick of sitting on my hands, we must ACT! I have a to-do list already! Seven hundred and fifty two entries. But time presses, so I’ll cut it down to three. Here!
Kharr! And who are you? I do not know you! Go, go away!
Find Rachel Lezvina on Asee-Teph and discuss the situation with her.

I've been watching you for quite some time now. You've come a long way on our path, the path of the Demonologists. However, this is only the beginning.

The next stage will be much more difficult. So, listen up.

In the Holy Land, where the war between the League and the Empire has been going on for several years, we have recently detected demonic activity. Yes, demons, like the ones you've encountered in Lab-13.

In addition, news has reached me that their activity has also been detected in the lands of the Priden people, and a thread of this story also leads to the Holy Land.

Well, the cultists must be destroyed. They are our main enemies. Not the Church or the Demon Hunters, although they are also dangerous - the cultists are our main enemy.

One of our members has already arrived at Asee - her name is Rachel. She is a skilled demonologist who prefers the form of a succubus.

Go to Asee and find Rachel. Talk to her and complete her tasks.

The cultists are ready to strike!

We will strike back!
Greetings! Be on your guard in the Holy Land, for danger is everywhere.

Retrieve 12 Flasks of Demon Blood from the cultists

There are several groups of cultists operating on Asee, and their attention is drawn to the Places of Power. I have been informed that these madmen have been spotted near the place of power on the Overcharged Shore and near the June Bastion. They are trying to desecrate these places using demonic blood - a substance of great power.

We have a good chance of securing this substance for ourselves. It needs to be studied.

You need to attack the cultists and recover the flasks of blood from their bodies. Then bring them to me.
Well, did you punish the scoundrels?
Yes, I can feel the energy boiling in these flasks from here...

Aho, frriend!

It's good to see you here, on the Holy Land. You must be surprised to see me here, right?

You shouldn't be. After hearing about the actions of Akyl the Grey, the Doolga conferred for a long time. We know too little about the world around us, but you can't wall off from birds flying overhead, eysh.

The time has come for the children of Howlem to learn about the threats that await them outside their homeland.

We also want to avenge our dead. These cultists deserve to die!

We could use you for what we have in mind, kylys. Will you hear me out?

Great, it's time to act, eysh!

You have proven your courage to the spirits of this land...

I wish I could find a steady source of this resource...

Devora... may seem eccentric. Pay that no mind.

Find Saad-Yrya and discuss your next steps with her

Hey, hey! The Doolga who came to this land will now gather at the full moon and perform the ritual. We will announce that this land will welcome the Pridens, eysh!

But the Holy Land is big. There are both hot jungles and cold taiga here. I'm talking about Eljune, the region that is more like Howlem than Asee-Teph.

The storyteller Saad-Yrya has already gone there, thinking of composing a song about the deeds of the Empire. Which ones, you ask?

There were Bayazes, true heroes of their peoples.

You've already heard about Tep, and this scoundrel managed to disrupt life on Igsh. He was behind the failures in Lab-13, the place where the Xadaganians work real miracles, advancing science. He and his assistants disrupted the work of the Zem scientists at the place known as ZIT HEADQUARTERS and helped this sinister creature get a new body. Tep also managed to destroy the heir of the Legendary Orc, Skulnar the Fierce. It would seem that the triumph of the scoundrel was close, but the local heroes dealt with these troubles.

Perhaps someday we will all combine our songs into one big song about the events of these years, eysh...

But now your path will take you to Saad-Yrya. She is in Takalik Harbor. As soon as you are sent there, find the storyteller.
That's why we need to conduct a ritual on Eljune, too. It's time for the Hunt!

They also helped the Gibberlings find a new home on the icy islands of Frozen Frontier.

Finally they got rid of Tep's chief hunhurr whose name was Mor'Ghuun!

Cold winds are blowing over Eljune, from the tops of the mountains to the forest lowlands. I am not a Doolga, but I feel the wrath of the spirits of this land - they are offended by what's coming from the Edge of Eternal Night, eysh. Animals run from west to east...

I'm sure your path will lead you there, once again pitting you against creatures from the void that are known as demons.

But now your task is different - slay the most dangerous beasts and birds on Eljune, proving that the Pridens are the greatest hunters.
The hunt on Eljune is over!
Find Huus-Birrak and discuss your next steps with him

I can already see that the spirits of Eljune have recognized us. After all, this land is very similar to our Howlem.

However, an even more difficult task awaits you. Do you remember Shoom Mound and the fury of Tep's followers?

Get ready for a new meeting. In the east, the Coba Plateau awaits you - a desecrated land tainted with the spirit of evil sorcery. And now, after the actions of the demon cultists, it's even worse.

But if you wanted to avenge the lost branch, you will have the opportunity.

Our sorcerer Huus-Birrak went to Coba. Only his ability to foresee the future will allow him to survive in the confrontation with Tep's Servants.

And you will help him with the ritual, eysh.

When your adventures take you to the Coba Plateau, try to find him.
Now the hardest part. We need to finish the hunt.

We need to select different types of beasts that live in different parts of this land.

Unfortunately, there is not much life here. Now you see what Howlem might be like if the Branches of Shoom succeeded in achieving their goal.

We managed to win then, but now I don’t know. Perhaps if the League and the Empire unite - like the Branches did once...

I hope the tailless have the wits to realize that. Otherwise…

But it's time. Complete the Hunt and prove to the spirits of the Coba Plateau that the Pridens are worth something, eysh!

Thank you, kylys.

The goal set before us by the Doolga has been achieved. The Pridens proved they deserve a place in this world. Now our people will be able to visit other allods, but remember this: for many, the path began right here, in the Holy Land.

Follow your path and don't forget the reason the Voices sent you here, eysh!
You know the Melting Isle is accessible now, right? Come see me if you want to hear the details.
Svetlana Demina, the Demonologist Trainer from Nezebgrad, wants to meet you.
Excellent. It will be useful in battle.

A guild is an organization that is founded and ran by citizens. Guild members can use it to socialize and work towards common goals together. If you're in a guild, you can be sure of help in times of trouble. There are many things you probably won't be able to do at all without the help of a guild.
I can help you found a new guild. To do that, you'll need to form a party of six friends that aren't in any guild yet. The party leader can then buy a Crystal of Unity from me and activate it to found a guild.
At that point, a name for the guild must be chosen. You can pick anything you like as long as the name is free of profanity and is not already being used by an existing guild.
As soon as the name has been selected and approved, I will enter the choice into my records. The party leader then becomes the guild leader while the other party members become its senior officers.
Later on the guild leader can accept new members, remove members, and promote or demote any of the members. They can also update the guild information and the guild's message of the day.
I strongly advise that you join a guild. Get your friends together and come see me. Remember, there is strength through unity!
A Symbol of Progress may be purchased by a Guild's Senior Officers, Treasurers or Leaders. Needed to advance the Guild to the next level.
h: Ask about a Symbol of Progress

t: You should work hard to help your guild progression. By purchasing this Symbol, not only you obtain a guild tabard for yourself, but also support your friends! A fair deal, isn't it?
I'm afraid you don't have enough money...
You are going to love it!
Wow! If you can afford this tabard, you must have achieved something really important. It will help you to progress further, so my offer is more than reasonable.
Sorry, but you don't have enough money.
Now you need to choose a banner that will suit your skills and combat style best.
Unfortunately, you can't have more than one banner at a time. You'll have to let go of your current banner to select a new one. It's your choice!
Just recently I sold you a cloak, and now you want to buy a banner. Your devotion to the guild is admirable! Few people are given the honor of carrying the banner.
Unfortunately, you can't have more than one banner at a time. You'll have to let go of your current banner to select a new one. It's your choice!
Sorry, but you don't have enough money.

Symbols of Advancement are an excellent way to develop your guild quickly and smoothly. They will help you raise your guild level up to 25! Bring me 6 Symbols for that.
Congratulations! It will take your guild just a while to become one of the most powerful in Sarnaut!

Guild Heraldry allows you to purchase Guild Accessories and use Guild Tactics that increase your allies' combat efficiency on Dominion.

All Guild members should put in some work to increase the Guild Heraldry rank.

Gather Marks of Deeds and reach a certain level of Prestige to gain a Heraldry rank.

Guild items can change their appearance depending on your Guild's Heraldry rank.

At Heraldry rank 1, the Guild Leader can get the ability to wear a shoulderpad with the guild symbol from the Clerk at the capital. The Leader can also assign the right to wear the shoulderpad to guild members.

Tactics boost all Guild members in Dominion battles.

Only the Guild Leader and officers may designate a Tactic.

Tactic selection requires spending some Marks of Deeds. The Tactic the Guild gets will be designated randomly.

h: Gain the ability to equip a shoulderpad with the guild symbol

t: Commendable! Are you sure about it?
Wish five Demonologists a happy holiday

The Demonologists are our allies like the Healers and Paladins. They just follow their own, special path! And today is their Pandemonium holiday. Today, all followers of this dark path are celebrating a great event - about a hundred years ago, a group of mages decided to unlock the secrets of astral creatures, wanting to protect the other inhabitants of Sarnaut from their deadly onslaught.

This time we decided to change the holiday program a bit! The Demonologists are the true heroes. Their path lies in darkness, but they also deserve a bit of light... And although the prejudice against them is still considerable, we ask you to wish every Demonologist you see a happy holiday! At least five will suffice. Let them know they are the heroes of this day!
You need to wish a happy holiday to five Demonologists! Different ones!
Excellent! Let the Demonologists know they are loved and treasured in this world! After all, the Pandemonium is their holiday!

According to the holiday plan, we need to wish the Demonologists a happy holiday - as many of them as we can! It's good that we have heroes like you.

Yes, yes, this time representatives of other classes can take part in the celebration and earn certain rewards.

To do this, you need to congratulate the real heroes of this holiday - the Demonologists. Five a day will be enough. Let them know they are the heroes of this day!
The more Demonologists receive holiday greetings from you, the closer you get to your prize!
Well, I see you have completed the program of the Pandemonium, so you've earned a reward!
Scare five players in the Fury form.

The path of the Demonologist is hidden in the dark...

The Fury form is best used for sneaking around and sudden attacks!

And today we ask you to demonstrate this skill. Scare five other players and you'll show your true worth as a Demonologist.
Hide and attack from the shadows!
Yes, you are a master of the form of the Beast, and therefore deserve a reward...
Seduce five players in the Tempting Predator form.

The Demonologist not only inspires fear, but also enchants and seduces…

The succubus or incubus form is most suitable for confusing the minds of enemies!

And we want you to demonstrate these skills today. Seduce five other players, and you will show the full power of the Demonologists!
Yes, you have mastered the Tempting Predator form, so the reward is yours!
Hug five players in the Giant form.

The Demonologists can do more than tear enemies apart! Protecting your allies is an equally important task.

Giants can protect you from enemy arrows and spears with their mighty body.

It's another reason the Demonologists should not be feared - like everyone else, they will fight to protect us in our hour of need. We ask you to prove your friendly intentions - hug five other players!
There is nothing like a strong friendly hug!
You have mastered the Giant form, so the reward is yours!
Complete the daily quests of the Pandemonium holiday.

Well, the holiday went well! Perhaps we'll hold more like this one.

And you get a special reward!

Citizens of the Empire! Today we celebrate the birthday of a person without whom there would be no Empire! The great leader, who led the Empire to prosperity and united under his rule the proud Xadaganians, the powerful Orcs, and the Arisen, to create a great nation! A person who personally fought against the demons during the Night of Astral Portals, and emerged victorious!
So we congratulate our constant leader, the Great Yasker with all our hearts, and wish him eternal health!
And you, if you like, can acquire some souvenirs of the holiday and some gifts from me.

Ugra-Xada is a very old word... Not many Xadaganians remember why their favorite holiday is called so.
Thousands years ago, before our world was shattered, the Great Nezeb left Kania, a state that was immersed in sin and vice. He met proud and honest nomadic tribe in the southern steppes. These skilled horsemen and fearless warriors called themselves the people of Ugra. They believed they were descendants of an ancient god Ugra. When Nezeb defeated their leader in an honest fight, nomads believed that he was god. The great Xadaganian state was born that day.
I'm offering special holiday items to Xadaganians during the celebration.

Sabantuy is a traditional orcish holiday. In the olden times, when the orcs were wild and led a nomadic life in the vast steppes, only once a year all the orcish tribes would gather for a celebration. Mighty fighters would compete in crushing rocks with their bare hands, drinking up barrels of beer on a wager, and hammering each other on the head until only the toughest orc with the strongest forehead would remain on his feet. The winner would earn a war club as a reward, as well as the respect of the tribe. A lot has changed since. The orcs have become esteemed citizens of the Empire, but the tradition of celebrating Sabantuy remains.
When the holiday rolls around, the orcs still drink beer by the bucket, hammer each other on the head with ritual clubs, make lots of noise and fun, and, of course, play their favorite game, goblinball. Besides, any orc that visits an artisan during the celebration can become a lucky owner of valuable gifts and souvenirs.

Opening of the Eyes and Lips was a burying ritual among the ancient Zem when the deceased person was symbolically reborn for the afterlife. The ritual gave the name to the day when the Arisen celebrate their return to life. Don't expect to hear the thunder of salutes and drunken shouting: the Arisen don't like wild celebrations much. Meditations, reflections and discussions about science and future of mankind are more to their liking. On that day, however, even they can't help but pamper themselves with wonderful holiday souvenirs!
h: Ask about the Opening of the Eyes

t: Hello! If you want to learn about Imperial holidays, I'll be glad to tell you! If you visit me during a celebration that applies to you, I will sell you special holiday items.

Oh! A Prophetic Card is a rare and valuable item.

If you are lucky enough, even one card might reward you generously. Why, of course! You can't toy with destiny!

It's not that simple, though. The card will not reveal its secrets by itself. In order to decipher it and receive your prize, you should buy an Ancient Compass from the Boutique. You may also choose to delve deeper into the secrets of the card by spending more Compasses and receive additional rewards.

Your chance of winning the grand prize increases with each attempt. Go for it, and may the odds be ever in your favor.

Hm... Your future is obscure, and even the Ancient Compass cannot help you. This is not a good moment to toy with fate.

I will highlight the time when you can use the Prophetic Card in your calendar.
Ladies should be treated with a gentle hand! We are delicate creatures, with frail bodies and hearts...
h: Ask for a piece of advice for a gallant chevalier.

t: What would I advise? Do not ever argue with him. Let him think he's the one to rule. But remember that it's not you who wants to be held, it's him who wants to hold you in his arms! You just have the kindness to assent!
h: Ask for a piece of advice for a beautiful lady

t: Complete the daily quests of the Dionysia festival.

Born from the struggle between chaos and order, the Aoidoi became a true sensation for the other people of Sarnaut. This majestic and wise civilization was granted a source of power comparable to the power of the gods themselves! The origin story of the Aoidoi is rather unique: the Aoidoi are children of two gods, creatures created by a cosmic catastrophe that put an end to a long confrontation. Now they celebrate the day when Polis, their first city, was founded. The festival itself was organized by Dominus Dionysius and named in his honor.

We all know the importance of the Dionysia for the Aoidoi who have left Ammer, so we are doing our best to make them feel at home.

This week we offer special quests for you that will show everyone three aspects of the Aoidos culture. Anyone can take part in the event!
To get a reward, you need to participate in holiday activities!

Well, the holiday went well! The world will remember the Dionysia week.

And you get a special reward!
Complete any quest of the Dionic Games and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Complete any quest of the Dionic Games.
For each trial completed I will reward you with a meteorite fragment that will prevent your allod from dissolving in the Astral.
Well, the trial is complete. Here's your reward!

These... people are hiding in Nezebgrad side streets. I will greatly appreciate it if you manage to get at least something from them!

We can't let every other maniac rat hand prophecies right and left!

It's bad for business, you know.
I will greatly appreciate it if you manage to get at least something from them!

Well, it's better than nothing. Perhaps, we should try our luck later. Early or late, one of them is going to crack, unless they're turned into test subjects.

Here. It's for your time and effort.

Oh, honey, I'm so worried... I can't make a correct prediction right now.

Can I tell you something? I have a feeling that you're in the middle of it.
I have a bad feeling, honey.

I had a dream, and in that dream there was some place forgotten by everyone...

And strange words came to mind... Here, listen.

I see it so clearly:

The tree is dying,

The ancient enemy has been awakened,

There is no rest for the dead!

Deadly Frost will come,

And countless enemies

Whose skin is white.

I see it through time.

Blood ties get stronger:

Pilgrim's children

Will take ragged weaving

And tie it into a whole.

What does it mean? I don’t know... But apparently there's a long road ahead of you... And there really is no rest for the dead! Anyway, the new ruler is a troubling one...

Give me your hand...
Look, can you see this line? There is a castle looming over a bleak and joyless village. The mysteries that are hidden deep within Darkwater you will discover.
These lines cross - Izbor Yavorsky, the head of the League Defenders, will give you a task himself. A druid and a priest are in dire need of aid.
A mournful wail of an unfortunate soul that is trapped by a force that is powerful and ugly. I fear that this force is going to be looking for you!

I didn't expect to see you so soon, but it's good that you've come. I saw you in my dream last night...
You went to go see our ambassador Klavdius Trojanov, he had a very important task for you. He sent you into a dark place and there were terrible enemies around every corner! Then I woke up in a cold sweat.
Do not go to the dark place alone!
h: Ask for a prediction for level 26

t:
How about you join me for a cup of tea? When you've finished, please give me your cup. Time for reading tea leaves.
Oh, look! Clearly, the leaves show the long and winding road - you will soon take a trip to Eljune to take care of many important matters!
A coin... Careful with Klavdius Trojanov's quest!
There's a shield and a mace... you will be helping Mikhail Selyaninov!
Drink some more. Now there's a tree - the gentle forestfolk will puzzle you with their dilemmas and you will uncover a great secret.
A storm cloud now! A terrible darkness is corrupting the Site of Power.
Drink. The Church of Light is in need of help. You must help them!
The last leaf remains... A monk robe means Zosim Nikulin will need you.
Hurry, dear... to Eljune!
h: Ask for a prediction for level 27

t:
We'll use the cards today. Do you see this? Two of Diamonds - for great struggle. I believe that Coba Plateau is in need of a hero! A grand problem awaits those, who...
Demon Hunters and Historians are in need for aid! In return they will help you.
h: Ask for a prediction for level 31

t:
Look me in the eye, dear, and try not to blink.
Judging by the expression of your eyes, you already know what lies in store for you. And yes, you are right.
I have seen a dragon! There will be a Great Dragon. Go see Izbor Yavorsky again before you leave. Although, perhaps he wouldn't know about the dragon himself...
h: Ask for a prediction for level 37

t:
I don't need the cards this time to tell you what you should do. Go see Aidenus immediately.
I've recently had some very bad premonitions... evil is hovering all around us. I'm sure that Aidenus is aware of it and has a new task to give to you.
The Great Mage will send you to a place unknown, but do trust him. Trust in those who have already fought the evil, the veterans of the Great Astral Campaign!

Perfect timing! Yesterday I had a prophetic dream!
I saw owls, thousands of owls - it's an omen! An omen of something massive! They were heading to Novograd and each of them had a letter in their beak. Inside the letters were weird stones.
Check your mailbox right away. Important news will lead you to the new lands, new adventures, and new secrets.

This is so sad! This mysterious Director who encourages everyone to find the Revelation is drawing more and more attention! People are talking about the secrets of the past, and no one cares about the future anymore! I tried glancing into the future.
Do you know what it holds? Darkness! Impenetrable darkness! I saw nothing!
Director serves his tricks, that's for sure. Maybe I should find this Revelation myself to dispel the darkness!
h: Ask for a prediction for level 45

t:
After the God of Darkness ran away, I recovered my ability to see through the veil of time!
Your future is tough and tricky. I see a coffin! This is a bad omen.Your eyes are empty and your heart is frozen. I see the endless sky reflected in the endless ocean. The sky and the sea are divided with lies and surrounded with deceit spoken by a madman trying to conquer the whole world...
There's a long road, to the stone house and many battles that would change the world forever. That's your destiny!

Show me your palm, darling.

You have a long road ahead of you, through the thicket of the forest, through ice and heat... I can see an awful disease in those far lands, the disease that you will have to fight. A mighty ship in the swirling Astral, two girls, ginger-haired and raven-haired, one laughing, one sobbing. Both are full of pride, but the pride won't do them good. I can see you walking hand in hand with one, fighting the other one, but they both will help you defeat the disaster, however unwilling they will seem to be...

I can see you talking to the ancient Gods, born before the Light, willing to save the world and your own soul from the disaster that is to come! I can also see that their time has gone, and young Gods will arrive, with burning hearts and glowing eyes... These Gods will shape the future and the fate of the world.

This is all I know, and there's nothing else. Go. May your road be straight.

Ah, I don't even need to hold your hand or read tea leaves! I can see everything only by looking at your face.

Soon a madman will ask you for help, and you won't be able to refuse. A new road, long and winding, is waiting for you.

I can see you walking across the land that once used to be thriving. But now there where once was forest, only black stumps are left. I can see plumes of smoke above white-stone fortresses. Fire and death, as far as the eye can see - the wings of war are unfolded above that allod. And you are at the forefront, as always. But don't you lose courage - an army of allies is right behind you!

And your enemy... No. No! It can't be! Again that horror, that blue oblivion with no life or soul! Ah, I can sense a power that's above gods and stronger than the Light... The time itself abides it. And I can't see what lies at the end of the road.

Please, be careful in your ventures. A single wrong move can ruin the whole world!

I'm looking in my divination sphere, and I'm seeing you exploring all of our beautiful Novograd. You will meet an important Elf and a cheerful Gibberling. They will offer very significant jobs...
Now you're clashing with the rebels in northern Lightwood. You will learn many new things. But above all else, I see you embarking on a perilous mission into a fortress captured by the enemy.
Be careful!
h: Ask for a prediction for level 6

t:
Greetings, my friend.

My prediction is really simple this time. Skulnar the Fierce will contact you. I can't tell you the reason.

But there's one thing I do know. You and I will meet again.

I'm leaving Novograd now. I'm going to the Holy Land. I had a bad dream, and my cards have been silent. So I'm thinking about getting a new deck from the Free Traders.

You should find Skulnar the Fierce. As far as I know, he's on Coldberg now.

Hello there!
Do you need a prediction? Since my services are paid for by the government, you'll be able to learn about your future without paying a single copper! If you're confused about your life path or what you should be doing, I can send you in the right direction immediately!
What level prediction do you need?

Nezebgrad's magic field has changed a lot lately, and not in a good way.

Not only strong mages and prophets faced the consequences. Average citizens sensed it, too. The public paranoia started. People experience insomnia and depression.

On top of that, psychologically disturbed individuals appeared in town. They foretell the future and spell doom, and the problem is, the may be right.
Just another blind kitten, whose eyes are about to open. Boy, do I like what I'm beginning to see! Our old names will mean nothing soon, you'll see.
It was... wonderful! Forgetting everything and starting afresh! This time we can make it. Right?

Oh, Darkness? Darkness is good. It hides everything I don't want to see. Darkness is the new order of things. The undisturbed, quiet world, ready for the new dawn, for the change. Ready for new beginnings.

It's very near. And it's far away... Ah...
h: The Darkness fills your mind. Fight it!

t:
Why am I here? I'm just a harbinger. The Dark condescended to you. It's the greatest honor.

What am I heralding? Ugh, the ability to listen has never been your forte. The message has been delivered. Now it's just a matter of time.

I remember... I remember a dream, which is a rare thing.

The dream about the future. About what's going to happen later, on another Earth, under a different sky. The grandchildren of our grandchildren are going to live in the light of Darkness. Our names and our deeds will be gradually erased from history.
h: You're talking nonsense. What's the meaning of all this?

t:
Ah, don't you worry, your help is valuable the way it is. You're on of the protagonist! The main character of the Show!

The monumental character, both tragic and comic, like the fate itself.

It's all right. The amazing new world will welcome everyone.

It's weird, though. All roads lead back to you, through all the wondrous places and mysterious times.
h: Move along. You are not welcome here.

t: Keep looking! They are around here somewhere!
h: I can't find the ghost named Artem Furazhkin

t: Great, now we can rest easy!
h: Yes! All ghosts have been found!

t:
Oh, the hero of the Empire! We must talk. It's very important. Could I have a minute of your valuable time?

I think that the Empire is in danger.
I think that the Empire is in danger.
We must do something fast. Even I have no idea where it will take us.
Talk to Alice in the Astral Academy

Good afternoon, my friend! Do you want to know how it all ended in Demon City or in another raid adventure you have yet to go on? There's now a way to find out, all thanks to the mysterious time traveler who appears here and there. She asked me to give you this message.

You can find her in the Astral Academy.
Talk to Naia Windina in the Astral Academy

My friend! Are you in urgent need of equipment? Is your gear hopelessly outdated?

I have a solution for you. You can get the most common basic equipment from Naia Windina, Assistant Relic Master. The level of these items depends on your progress, so the more feats you perform, the better the equipment you will get.
I give out things to the heroes of the Empire for free. As many times as you need! But you won't be able to sell them.
Talk to Yasskul Khnum on Avilon.

Good afternoon, my friend!

You have done a great many different things. And believe me - we inform the historians of your exploits daily. They have a special department, or rather, the Order - of chroniclers that keep records of all the deeds performed by great individuals. They collect all the documents, stories and even rumors - and reproduce them if necessary.

If you want to remember what you have learned of particular importance, you should speak with Yasskul Khnum on Avilon.
Greetings! I've heard about your deeds. In terms of description length, they are close to many other dossiers we have - on Great Mages, for example.
Talk to Raisa Boltalkina in the Astral Academy

Good afternoon, my friend! Want to know all the latest news? Or remember your past adventures? The famous traveler Raisa Boltalkina can tell you about them.

You can find her in the Astral Academy.
I have all the latest news! But I can also tell you about the deeds of the past days!
Travel to Tropical Atoll and return the ball to Zouzou "Seven Steps"
The blue ball wants someone to play with it. You need to return it to its owner. And then play with it!

Hello, hello! Welcome to the Tropical Atoll!

...Oh, that's our ball! So that's where it's hiding, we've been looking all over the beach for it.

Here's your reward for finding it!
Win in any Skirmish and receive a reward from Zinaida Krichalkina.

The Treasure Hunt has begun! Don't miss a chance to try your luck! With the help of Prophetic Cards and Ancient Compasses, you can win rare mounts and gorgeous costumes!

Holiday Committee Officials will reward heroes with Ancient Compasses for their feats!

Join the Skirmishes! Witch's Hollow, Deserted Farm, Training Camp, Tower of Order, Battle for Cargallas, and Old Fortress await you. Then come back for your reward!
Who knows what kind of treasures are still waiting to be discovered?
Great! Here's your reward. Good luck in your treasure hunting!
Defeat the toughest opponent on an Astral allod of the current stage and receive the reward form Zinaida Krichalkina.

Treasure Hunting has begun! Don't miss the chance to test your luck! With Prophetic Cards and Ancient Compasses you can win rare mounts and gorgeous costumes, the like of which you will not find in all of Sarnaut!

Holiday Committee Officials will reward heroes with Ancient Compasses for their feats.

Defeat the toughest opponent on an Astral Allod and return for your reward!
Who knows what kind of treasures are still waiting to be discovered?
Great! Here's your reward. Good luck in your treasure hunting!
Vranomir Temnov, the heretic trainer from Novograd, wants to meet you.
Excellent. It will be useful in battle.
Receive the Right Halves of the Contest Medal from Rogneda Whistlie in Novograd.

Do you want to participate in goblinball? I will give you a few Right Halves of the Contest Medal. For each completed game, you will receive a certain amount of the Signs of the Athlete. A hundred of these signs can be traded for the Left Half of the Contest Medal, and two different halves can be combined into an intact medal.
Ole, ole-ole-ole! The League is the champion!
Kill 20 Demon Invaders on Ammer and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?

Here is the pledge: you need to kill 20 Demon Invaders on Ammer. Aoidoi avoid fighting and violence, so we have to do the dirty job.

If you do that, your pledge will be fulfilled.
Kill 20 Destroyer Invaders on Sogot and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?

You must eliminate 20 Destroyers on Sogot.

Do that to carry out your pledge.
Defeat one of the world monsters

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must take: destroy one of the world monsters.

Do that to carry out your pledge.
Kill 20 Goblin Hunters or Goblin Tormentors in Foul Dale on Umoir and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must give: eliminate 20 Goblin Hunters or Goblin Tormentors in Foul Dale.

Do that to carry out your pledge.

Do that to carry out your pledge.
Eliminate 20 Snow Spiders on Isa and report back to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must give: eliminate 20 Snow Spiders on Isa.

Do that to carry out your pledge.
Eliminate 20 Distorted Spiders on Jigran and report back to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must give: eliminate 20 Distorted Spiders on Jigran.

Do that to carry out your pledge.
Kill 20 Path of Fire Heretics on Xadagan and report about the pledge fulfilled to the Guild's Clerk, Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must give: eliminate 20 Path of Fire Heretics on Xadagan.

Do that to carry out your pledge.

Find an Aoidos teacher, take part in a lesson and earn 2000 alchemy points. Or organize a lesson yourself.
Find students, give them a lesson and earn 2000 alchemy points. Or become a student yourself.

The Aoidoi by nature have a subtle knowledge of the world around them. It is manifested in their ability to transform one matter into another!

After all, they created their cities from stone literally with their mind! All matter easily submits to their will.

This makes them extremely good at alchemy. The famous alchemist Trismegistos astonished even the Great Mages! I suggest you take a couple of lessons, but you need to find a teacher first! Or maybe you know enough to teach it?

After all, you created your cities from stone literally with your mind! All matter easily submits to your will.

This makes you extremely good at alchemy. The famous alchemist Trismegistos astonished even the Great Mages! I suggest you give one such lesson to all people of Sarnaut! But first you need to find students! Or perhaps you'd like to become a student yourself?
How are the alchemy lessons going?

Have you learned anything new? Excellent! We are lucky we have the Aoidoi, right?
Have you managed to teach anyone? Or perhaps you've learned something yourself? Excellent! We are lucky we have the Aoidoi!

Find an Aoidos teacher, take part in a lesson and earn 2000 poetry points. Or organize a lesson yourself.
Find students, give them a lesson and earn 2000 poetry points. Or become a student yourself.

The Aoidoi are born with extensive knowledge of history, and what is the best way to tell stories? Epic poems, of course! The Orphean school is particularly adept at this.

I'm sure that over time all our deeds - both yours and mine - will be sung by the Aoidoi!

During this week of the Dionysia, the Aoidoi can show other residents of Sarnaut the true power of art. I suggest you take a couple of lessons, but you need to find a teacher first! Or maybe you know enough to teach it?

Have you learned anything new? Excellent! We are lucky we have the Aoidoi, right?
Have you managed to teach anyone? Or perhaps you've learned something yourself? Excellent! We are lucky we have the Aoidoi!
Complete any quest of the Dionic Games and report to Klim Pisarev.
Complete any quest of the Dionic Games.
Each completed trial will reward you with a meteorite shard, which will keep you allod from being devoured by the Astral.
Well, the trial is complete. Here's your reward!

I think you should talk to them. You might understand more from the nonsense they're saying... They're still in town, reveling in people's fear. The worst of them were banished, but the quieter ones were left behind.

Tell me if you manage to figure out what they're up to. They're casting a shadow over my good name, you know.
I think you should talk to them. You might understand more from the nonsense they say...

Just as I thought. Nothing. Thank you anyway, honey. Try again later, they might mention something useful.

Here. It's for your time and effort.
Talk to Alice in the Astral Academy

Greetings, my friend! Do you want to know how it all ended in Demon City or in another raid adventure you have yet to go on? There's now a way to find out, all thanks to the mysterious time traveler who appears here and there. She asked me to give you this message.

You can find her in the Astral Academy.
Talk to Naia Windina in the Astral Academy

My friend! Are you in urgent need of equipment? Is your gear hopelessly outdated?

I have a solution for you. You can get the most common basic equipment from Naia Windina, Assistant Relic Master. The level of these items depends on your progress, so the more feats you perform, the better the equipment you will get.
I give out things to the heroes of the League for free. As many times as you need! But you won't be able to sell them.
Talk to Yasskul Khnum on Avilon.

Greetings, my friend!

You have done a great many different things. And believe me - we inform the historians of your exploits daily. They have a special department, or rather, the Order - of chroniclers that keep records of all the deeds performed by great individuals. They collect all the documents, stories and even rumors - and reproduce them if necessary.

If you want to remember what you have learned of particular importance, you should speak with Yasskul Khnum on Avilon.
Greetings! I've heard about your deeds. In terms of description length, they are close to many other dossiers we have - on Great Mages, for example.
Then come back when you have the money. Or take an introductory tour - on Aidenus's orders, a token amount is given as a reward at each stage.

You've come to the right place if you want to learn more battle techniques. Novograd is filled with experienced teachers! All of them are under orders right now to train anyone who wants to learn. In times like these the League needs everyone to be at their best!

We have many important citizens right here in Novograd. There are the ambassadors of the Elves and the Gibberlings, as well as the leaders of the Church of Light and the League Defenders.
You can even meet Aidenus himself. Aidenus is the leader of the League, you know. We all owe our lives to his guidance.

Sarnaut is full of new and ancient secrets, but unfortunately we only know a few of them! That's why the League has been working hard to solve as many mysteries as possible. I can tell you everything I know about the knowledge that's already available to the public.
Squabble and Carnage the Roughnecks, two Orc mercenaries who can be found on Coldberg. On behalf of Sigurd the Swindler, we are happy to equip those who have won the trust of the Free Traders.
h: Ask about the Free Traders' quartermasters

t: The Detective Bureau's latest data suggests that the Historians can be found on the remote island of Avilon. If you get there, find Arnaud de Desirae and Firk the Roughneck. The great historian Zayan instructed them to deal with equipment for those who would earn the trust of the Historians.

It's not easy to find the Demon Hunters! They never stay long in one place. But we know from intelligence reports that a small expedition stopped on a recently discovered archipelago called the Dragon Ring. And if you want to earn the trust of the Hunters and get their equipment, find Rustle the Forester, Sofia Lozhkina, and Vasily Gurov in their camp.
h: Ask about the Demon Hunters' quartermasters

t: The Overlords are a faction of the Wormfaces that live in the Gipat Caverns. Very little is known about them, but now, thanks to the Director, we will be able to communicate with them. It is said that they generously reward anyone who helps them. You will need to contact the master of rewards Lord Krosus and his assistants.

Not so long ago, a mysterious Alice appeared in our world. She claims to have traveled through time, so she knows what happened in the past and will happen in the future. Perhaps she's lying, but who knows? It's hard to know what to believe these days. But if you are wondering what might happen to you in the future if you go on newly unlocked raid adventures, then you need to talk to her.

The mysterious Alice that suddenly appeared in our world is of great interest to the City Council. Alas, our agents have been unable to locate her. But ordinary heroes like you can easily meet her. If you would like an opportunity to look into the future and see what is happening there, you should reach out to her. Of course, it's quite a gamble, but perhaps you will be able to learn more than the Detective Bureau has.
h: Ask about Alice, the time traveler

t:
Here's the scoop - there's a bank that just opened in the city.

All citizens are allowed to store things there so we don't have to lug everything around with us. However, it's still partially under construction.

I heard that Aidenus isn't pleased about this, so now the Construction Council is running around like a bunch of chickens with their heads cut off trying to get it all done by the deadline. I sure hope they make it!

In addition to fighting the League and other enemies in the open world, the brave defenders of the Empire can take part in battles at special training grounds. Here, death means nothing, because everyone is resurrected by the Great Mages. And those who win can receive special rewards. You can learn more from the quartermasters of the respective skirmishes. You can find them in the main square not far from the southern gates. Boyko Sokolov will tell you about the Guild Dominion, Gaal-Bran the Gloomy - about rating combats, and the Roughneck Family - about random skirmishes. In addition, you can also find merchants selling rare goods there, like trophies from the battlefields.

The League Defenders are the best soldiers in the League. They have proven their worth in battle against demons. It is hard to earn their trust - where can you find demons these days?! Only in deep Astral. If you manage that, go to Aidenus' Tower. You will find two knights there: Sergey Orlovsky and Dmitry Devishev. There is also Sofia Kanianskaya. They will offer you valuable goods from their arsenal.

Not so long ago, the Elves were ruled by the House de Desirae. And even now this House has strong ties to the League. It is their representatives, Gregoire and Jules, who are in charge of the elven rewards. They can be found in the Elven Quarter, and the main office of their House is now located on Tenebra.

The Novograd Construction Council manages all of the capital's affairs. At the moment their main focus is completing the construction of Novograd, as you might have guessed. They also attend to the needs of the surrounding area of Lightwood. I urge you to visit them in the Trade District and volunteer your services.

We can't wage wars all the time! Sometimes we need more peaceful activities like swimming on a summer night or jumping over a fire! And there is a more fashionable activity named goblinball. It's an ancient Orc sport, and now anyone can participate. Yes, yes, the League also participates - with Aidenus's approval, they say. There are also championships for those talented enough. You can discuss all that with the sisters Rogneda Whistlie and Barbell the Referie who can be found on the main square near the southern gates.

The Gibberlings have recently made a new home in the colder reaches of Kania. Siveria and Frozen Frontier, to be exact. I hear they're settling down there until they can find their ancient homeland of Isa. Their leader is named Froddy the Fidget, and he's in Frozen Frontier right now. However, his ambassadors can be found in the Gibberling District.

Not the trainer, the trainers! You need to find the Raw Family, to be precise. They're some especially jovial Gibberlings that reside in the Gibberling District. They know all there is to know about leatherworking.

You're looking for Felix de Grandeur in the Elven District. Word on the street is that Aidenus wants to nominate him to be a Great Mage. He's very skilled! I'm sure he can teach you anything you want to know.

Pierre de Desirae represents the interests of the Elves here in Novograd. He speaks for Marguerite de Desirae, the head of the ruling House de Desirae, but she lives on the allod of Tenebra. I hear she has her hands quite full with some important matters, for she hasn't visited Novograd herself in a long time.

A beautiful girlhandsome guy caught your eye? Then what's the problem? Find yourselves a big haystack and have a go at it! But if it's serious, then a priest can marry you. We have one in Novograd, her name is Helena Bugakova. Feel free to ask her. And you won't be committing a sin.

The Servants of the Light are beautiful maidens that have devoted their entire lives to the Light! They can be dashing Elven women or noble Kanian girls.
They're everywhere and they're always ready to help travelers by selling drops of mirra. You can visit the Church of Light in the Main Square to find one of these wonderful Servants.
h: Ask about the Servants of the Light

t: Our world is full of various mounts - both living and mechanical. Progress does not stand still! There is always something new coming out. Ivan Ovsov, an experienced horse breeder, can tell you all about them. He is well versed in technology - he can tell you about assault shells, for example. You can find him in Lightwood, in front of the main gates to Novograd.

So you've reached a high level of development? It's time to get a new kind of equipment - regular quartermasters can't help you anymore. You can get it from Naia Windina who can be found in the Astral Academy next to the forge. It's not the best possible equipment, but it should do for a start. Naia will give you a full set of items, and you can change their stats using special insignias.

Do you think you might make a decent herald? Your skills will not go to waste, because the Free Traders, with Aidenus's permission, have launched a special program to get new heroes to participate in adventures in our world. And you can help them. You can find out the details from the Unselfish Family, representatives of the Tycoons, and you can find them in the bank on the main square of Novograd.

Yaroslav Radiev is who you seek. He's an experienced priest of the Church of Light. His whole life is dedicated to spreading the teachings of Tensess and he will be pleased to speak with you. You can find him in the church in the Main Square!

They say meeting Victor Voronov brings good luck. He saved no less than several dozen Gibberling children during an octulhu's attack on some settlers' ship. He blinded that Astral beast using the light of his faith! You'll find him near the Main Square of Novograd.

Our world holds many secrets. Lovewise Catfish, once a member of the Historians, was invited by Aidenus to come to Novograd and collect information about these secrets.
He searches for knowledge about recent events as well as those from many, many years ago. If you happen to find some important piece of information, head to Aidenus' Tower and tell Lovewise right away.

The ruling Elven House de Desirae is known for studying dark magic. The teacher of this magic, Rene de Desirae, hails from that house. If you're interested in seeing him, you can find him in the Elven District.
Marianne de Ardeur was the first of her people to accept Tensess into her heart. Voisvet Belov used to lead the Church of Light, but after his disappearance this great honor was passed on to her.

Valentina de Ardeur is a famous seamstress. She makes the most beautiful ball gowns you've ever seen! She can teach you everything you need to know about tailoring. Look for her in the Elven District.

In the past, very few allods in Kania had portals, but now we are in a new era of prosperity! Portals have been built all across the land, and we can go anywhere that we need to! You can speak with the Portal Keeper, Hugues de Delice, to ask more about how all of this works. He can be found in Aidenus' Tower.

Time travel? A miracle? No, it's reality. It is quite possible these days - and some mysterious quartermasters have appeared, ready to reward other time travelers! You can find them on one of the Gipat shards known as the Crossroads!
Here, take this manual, the tool, and the ingredients. If you need more, you can buy them from the master. They will also check your task.

Talk to Ermina de Delice in the Astral Academy.

Greetings, my friend! Want to know all the latest news? Or remember your past adventures? The famous traveler Ermina de Delice can tell you about them.

You can find her in the Astral Academy.
I have all the latest news! But I can also tell you about the deeds of the past days!

The Treasure Hunt has begun! Don't miss a chance to try your luck! With the help of Prophetic Cards and Ancient Compasses, you can get your hands on rare treasures!

Holiday Committee Officials will reward heroes with Ancient Compasses for their feats!

Join the Skirmishes! Witch's Hollow, Deserted Farm, Training Camp, Tower of Order, Battle for Cargallas, and Old Fortress await you. Then come back for your reward!
Who knows what kind of treasures are still waiting to be discovered?
Great! Here's your reward. Good luck in your treasure hunting!
